We need to propose a retrosynthesis route (max 3 steps) to target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need leaves commercially available, total price <=9999 (we can't check price but assume buyable). Need to construct route using templates.

We have some buyable building blocks: Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1 (p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride), Nc1ccc(N)cc1 (p-phenylenediamine?), actually that's an aniline with amine? Smiles "Nc1ccc(N)cc1" is p-phenylenediamine (two amines). Also C=CC(=O)Cl (acryloyl chloride). Also C=CC(=O)Nc1ccc(N)cc1 (acrylamide with aniline). Also maybe we need phenyl amine (aniline) for the amide part.

Target has two aromatic rings: a tolyl sulfonamide attached to another phenyl ring bearing a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (anilide). Actually structure: p-tolyl-sulfonyl attached to phenyl which has a trans-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH2? Wait: /C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N is a cinnamamide with an aniline (para-aminophenyl) attached to amide nitrogen (so anilide). So the second phenyl ring (c2ccc(... )cc2) is attached to sulfonyl and to the trans-alkene amide side chain.

Thus retrosynthesis could be: disconnection of sulfonamide: start from p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride (commercial) reacting with aniline (the second phenyl ring with amine). But the second phenyl ring also has the side chain attached via para position? Actually the sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the second phenyl ring (the one bearing the side chain). So we need an aniline that already has the side chain attached (i.e., 4-(cinnamoylamino)aniline). So we could first make that aniline via amide formation between 4-aminophenyl (p-aminophenyl) and acryloyl chloride to give 4-(acrylamido)aniline (C=CC(=O)Nc1ccc(N)cc1). That's commercially available? We saw C=CC(=O)Nc1ccc(N)cc1 is not directly buyable but we can synthesize via reacting acryloyl chloride with p-phenylenediamine (or aniline). Actually p-phenylenediamine has two amines; we need mono-acylated product. Could use protecting group but maybe we can use 4-aminophenylamine (p-phenylenediamine) and acylate one amine selectively? Might be tricky.

Alternative: start from 4-aminobenzaldehyde? Not.

Simplify: Use two steps: Step1: Form amide between acryloyl chloride and 4-aminophenyl (p-aminophenyl) to give the side chain aniline (C=CC(=O)Nc1ccc(N)cc1). This could be done directly; both reagents are buyable (acryloyl chloride, p-phenylenediamine). But need selectivity; maybe we assume it works.

Step2: Sulfonylation of that aniline with p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride to give final product.

Thus total 2 steps.

We need to provide route JSON with reactions and template IDs. Need to find appropriate template IDs for sulfonylation (sulfonyl chloride + amine -> sulfonamide) and for amide formation (acyl chloride + amine -> amide). Use search to find templates.

Search for sulfonamide formation: molecule_smiles of product maybe "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1" but we need product with sulfonamide attached to aniline? Actually product of sulfonylation: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)Nc2ccc(N)cc2)cc1 (without side chain). Let's search.
